import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set up the style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = (14, 10)

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Color palette for species
palette = {'setosa': '#2ecc71', 'versicolor': '#3498db', 'virginica': '#e74c3c'}

# 1. Scatter plot: Petal Length vs Petal Width (most discriminative features)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(subset['petal_length'], subset['petal_width'], 
                label=species.capitalize(), alpha=0.7, s=60, c=palette[species], edgecolors='white')
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species', fontsize=10)

# 2. Scatter plot: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(subset['sepal_length'], subset['sepal_width'], 
                label=species.capitalize(), alpha=0.7, s=60, c=palette[species], edgecolors='white')
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species', fontsize=10)

# 3. Box plot: All measurements by species
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df_melted = df.melt(id_vars=['species'], 
                     value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'],
                     var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value (cm)')
df_melted['Measurement'] = df_melted['Measurement'].str.replace('_', ' ').str.title()
sns.boxplot(data=df_melted, x='Measurement', y='Value (cm)', hue='species', 
            palette=palette, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Measurements by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Species', fontsize=9)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

# 4. Violin plot: Petal Length distribution (most discriminative single feature)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', palette=palette, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticklabels([s.capitalize() for s in df['species'].unique()])

# Add main title
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Species Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
